name: Adapted Adventures: Crystal Cave
source:
Adapted Adventures: Crystal Cave is a short visual novel following our protagonist Hikari and team HARK as they (Hikari, Audrey, Robin, and Kyra) investigate disappearances in the neo crystal world.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1378670/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《Adapted Adventures: Crystal Cave》是一部短篇视觉小说，讲述主人公Hikari与HARK小队的冒险。小队由Hikari、奥黛丽、罗宾和凯拉组成，她们将一同调查新水晶世界中的失踪事件。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1378670/]Steam[/url]]
